# ex: contextAppropriate allows HasOk expressions in 2-variable assignment
ex {
	var m map[string]int
	var k string
	Get(m, k) -> m[k]
}
-- x.go --
package p

func Get(m map[string]int, k string) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := m[k]
	return v, ok
}

func f() {
	m := map[string]int{"a": 1}
	v, ok := Get(m, "a")
	_, _ = v, ok
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -7,6 +7,6 @@

 func f() {
 	m := map[string]int{"a": 1}
-	v, ok := Get(m, "a")
+	v, ok := m["a"]
 	_, _ = v, ok
 }
